scaffoldNotice: This app is scaffolded and uses the OruSchools theme. Features arrive in the implementation plan.
syncChangesPending: {count, plural, one{{count} change pending} other{{count} changes pending}}
errorServerUnreachable: We could not reach the school server. Your work is saved on this phone.
saasSignInIntro: This area is for the OruSchools platform owner.
authPhoneHint: Include the country code, for example +91 98765 43210
authOr: or
authErrorCredentials: The email or password is not correct.
authErrorTooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
authErrorNetwork: We could not reach the sign-in service. Check your connection.
authErrorPopupClosed: The Google window was closed before sign-in finished.
authErrorCode: That code is not correct or has expired.
authErrorPhone: Enter the number with its country code.
authErrorGeneric: We could not sign you in. Try again.
saasNoAccessTitle: This account cannot use the platform area
saasNoAccessBody: Sign in with the platform owner account. Schools sign in at their own address.
saasSchoolsEmptyBody: Create the first school so its team can sign in.
saasSchoolSubdomainHint: Letters, numbers and hyphens, for example greenfield. It cannot be changed later.
saasSuspendBody: Nobody at this school can sign in until you reactivate it.
saasLoadFailed: We could not load the schools
errorForbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errorInvalidRequest: Some details are not valid. Check the fields and try again.
errorConflict: That already exists. Choose a different name or address.
errorRateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errorUpstream: The server is busy. Try again shortly.
errorInternal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
errorNetwork: We could not reach the server. Check your connection.
errorTimeout: The server took too long to answer. Try again.
saasAdminIntro: They get an email to set their own password. You can add one administrator here; after that the school manages its own people.
saasAdminAdded: Administrator added. An email to set their password was sent to {email}.
saasAdminAddedNoEmail: Administrator added. They can sign in with a code sent to their phone.
saasAdminEmailFailed: Administrator added, but the email could not be sent. Ask them to use “Forgot password” on the sign-in page.
saasAdminExists: This school already has an administrator.
errorAccountExists: An account with this email or number already exists.
authResetSent: If an account exists for that address, an email to set a new password is on its way.
webSignInIntro: Use the account your school gave you.
webSchoolNotFoundTitle: We could not find this school
webSchoolNotFoundBody: Check the address, or ask your school for its web address.
webNoSchoolBody: Each school has its own web address, for example greenfield.oruschools.com.
webNoAccessTitle: You do not have access to {name}
webNoAccessBody: Ask your school's administrator to add you, then sign in again.
webLoadFailed: We could not load your account
webDashboardEmptyBody: Numbers and tasks will appear here as your school's modules are set up.
webComingTitle: This module is not ready yet
webComingBody: It will appear here when it is built.
errorPageTitle: Something went wrong on this page
errorUploadInvalid: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image up to 2 MB.
errorUploadFailed: The file could not be uploaded. Try again.
ntBellUnread: {count, plural, one{{count} unread notification} other{{count} unread notifications}}
ntSettingsHint: Hidden kinds are kept, not deleted.
ntLoadFailed: The notifications could not be loaded.
lvOverBalance: That is more than the days left.
lvOverlap: That overlaps other leave of the same person.
lvIsPaid: Paid leave (takes days from a yearly allowance)
lvNoTypes: There are no leave types yet.
lvTypeInUse: This leave type has requests and cannot be removed.
lvPaidNeedsQuota: A paid type needs a number of days a year, whole or half.
lvBelowTaken: That is less than the days already taken.
lvStandardHint: The yearly allowance of the type, until the person asks for it.
lvWholeOrHalf: Use a whole or half number of days, like 12 or 7.5.
sbThisMonth: {count, plural, one{{count} cover this month} other{{count} covers this month}}
sbNoCandidates: Nobody is free and qualified for this lesson.
sbNoNeeds: No lessons are waiting for cover in this range.
sbHasOwnLesson: That teacher has a lesson of their own then.
sbOnLeave: That teacher is on leave then.
sbAlreadyCovering: That teacher already covers another class then.
sbSameAsAbsent: The teacher who is away cannot cover their own lesson.
sbNoLongerNeeded: That lesson no longer needs cover.
sbChanged: Something changed meanwhile. Look at the list again.
plNote: For each person with approved unpaid leave: the monthly pay times the days, divided by the school's working days in the month. Nothing is deducted until HR applies it.
plNone: There is no approved unpaid leave in this month.
plWithout: Unpaid leave but no payslip in this run: {names}
plAboveGross: That is more than the month's pay.
plNotDraft: Only a draft run can change.
gbNoTermsBody: Add a term under Exams and terms first.
gbNoExams: There are no exams in this term yet.
gbAboveMax: A mark is above the most possible for this exam.
gbNotAMark: A mark must be a number with at most one decimal.
gbAbsentNoMarks: A student who is absent cannot have marks.
gbExamExists: This class already has an exam with that name for this subject and term.
gbBelowMark: The most marks cannot be below a mark already given.
gbBandsNone: No grade bands are set. Marks show a percentage without a grade.
gbBandsHint: Together the bands must cover 0 to 100 with no gap and no overlap. A percentage is never rounded up into a better band.
gbBandOverlap: Two bands cover the same percentages.
gbBandGap: There is a gap between two bands.
gbBandStart: The lowest band must start at 0.
gbBandEnd: The highest band must end at 100.
gbBandLabelTaken: Two bands have the same grade.
gbBandBad: Each band needs whole numbers from 0 to 100, and a grade name.
gbPending: {count, plural, one{{count} exam has no mark yet and is left out} other{{count} exams have no mark yet and are left out}}
gbNoCard: This student has no report card for this term.
attNotTaken: Attendance has not been taken for this class on this date. Everyone is shown as present until it is.
attLockedNote: This day is locked. Only a correction can change it, and the old and new values are recorded.
attNoStudents: This class has no students yet.
attDayLocked: This day is locked. Ask the Academic administrator for a correction.
attFutureDate: That date has not come yet.
attMissingEmpty: Nothing is waiting for this date.
attNamesHint: Rename a status for your school. What it means and its colour stay the same.
satTitleNote: Who is at work on a date. Times are in Indian Standard Time.
satNeedsIn: Enter the time in as well.
satNone: Nobody is on the staff list yet.
ttNoYearTitle: There is no active academic year
ttNoYearBody: Make an academic year active first.
ttNoPeriodsBody: Start from a standard day or a short day, or add periods one by one.
ttClassBusy: This class already has a lesson then.
ttTeacherBusy: This teacher is already teaching another class then.
ttTeacherNotSubject: This teacher does not teach that subject.
ttNotWorkingDay: The school does not work on that day.
ttPeriodInUse: A period that has lessons in it cannot be removed or made a break.
ttPeriodLabelTaken: Another period already has that name.
ttPeriodStartTaken: Another period already starts at that time.
ttPeriodEnd: The end must be after the start.
ttNoLoad: No lessons have been placed yet.
ttIsBreak: This is a break: nothing is taught in it
notifLeaveRequestedBody: {name} asked for {days} day(s) of {typeName} leave from {startDate} to {endDate}.
notifLeaveSubstitutionBody: {name} is on leave from {startDate} to {endDate}. Choose substitutes on the substitution board.
notifLeavePayrollBody: {name} has approved unpaid leave from {startDate} to {endDate}. Review the proposed deduction in the payroll run.
webDownloadFailed: The file could not be made. Try again.
webTotalsOnly: You can see the totals but not the individual payments.
peoSearch: Search by name or enrolment no.
peoNoStudentsBody: Add the first student, or import a list.
hrpSearch: Search by name or employee no.
hrpNoMatch: No staff member matches this search.
hrpConfirmApprove: Approve payroll for {month}? {count} staff, net pay {net}. This cannot be undone.
hrpConfirmPay: Record payment of {net} for {month}? This cannot be undone.
hrpConfirmDelete: Delete the draft for {month}? You can make it again.
hrpNoRunsBody: Set up salaries on each staff member first, then create the month's run.
feeFindStudent: Find a student by name or enrolment no.
feeConfirmReverse: Reverse this payment of {amount}? The invoice becomes unpaid again and the receipt is cancelled. This cannot be undone.
feeBillIntro: Makes an invoice for every instalment due on or before the date, for the students of the level you choose (or all). Instalments already billed are left alone.
feePreviewResult: {created} invoices would be created. Already billed: {already}. Students without fees set up: {without}.
feeNoInvoicesBody: Set up fees, then bill them.
feeNoItems: No fees in this structure yet
setConfirmActivate: Make {name} the active academic year? New students, invoices and receipts will use it.
setBrandHint: A dark colour written as # and six letters or digits, so white text on it is easy to read.
setImportIntro: Choose a CSV file. It is checked first, and nothing is saved until you confirm.
setCheckResult: {valid} of {total} rows are ready. {errors} rows have problems.
hrrNoRunsTitle: No approved or paid pay runs in this year
webFieldRoleTitle: Your role works in the mobile app
webFieldRoleBody: This web area is for administrators. Open the OruSchools app on your phone.
usrConfirmRole: Change {name} to {role}? Their screens change at once.
usrConfirmSuspend: Suspend {name}? They cannot sign in until you reactivate them.
usrConfirmRemove: Remove {name} from this school? They lose their place here.
usrAccountIntro: For a person who works at the school and does not have an account yet. They sign in with email or a mobile number.
usrLinkSent: A link to set a password was sent to {email}.
usrLinkFailed: The account was created, but the link could not be sent.
usrInvitationIntro: Makes a one-time code. Give it to the person: after they sign in they enter it to join this school.
usrInvitationCode: One-time code. Copy it now: it is shown only once.
usrJoined: You joined as {role}. Loading your school…
errorInvitationInvalid: This code is not valid, or it has expired. Ask the school for a new one.
errorEmailNotVerified: Verify your email address first, then try again.
errorOwnMembership: You cannot change your own role. Ask another system administrator.
mobSchoolChoiceBody: Your account works at more than one school. Choose the one to open.
mobNoAccessTitle: This account cannot use this app
mobLockBody: Confirm it is you to open OruSchools.
mobUnlockFailed: We could not confirm it is you. Try again.
mobSignOutBody: Everything saved on this phone for this school will be removed.
mobSignOutOwed: {count, plural, one{{count} change has not reached the school yet and will be lost.} other{{count} changes have not reached the school yet and will be lost.}}
mobAppLockTitle: Ask for my fingerprint, face or screen lock
mobAppLockBody: Asked again after the app has been in the background for a minute.
mobAppLockUnavailable: This phone has no screen lock set up.
mobHomeSoonBody: Classes, attendance and leave arrive in the next updates.
